ruleDefinitions.name: Potential RDP Session Hijacking Activity
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential RDP Session Hijacking activity on Windows systems

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\tscon\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "tscon\.exe") AND (process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384"))
